text:
Sarah (Sales): Customer InfoSec asks for logging/audit evidence for SIG review. They want: admin activity logs, retention policy, SIEM integration, sample logs. POC deadline EOD Wed. Anyone able to gather artifacts?

Ian (Solutions Eng): I can pull example audit export + retention docs. Which customer? env = 'acme-corp'

Sarah (Sales): acme-corp. Need redacted logs and steps to ingest into Splunk/Datadog. Also timestamp range last 30 days.

Olivia (Security): We should include: 1) audit log schema doc, 2) retention config (S3 lifecycle + DB TTL), 3) sample event with redaction, 4) architecture diagram. I can write a short cover note for SIG/CAIQ.

Ian (Solutions Eng): I'll export using admin-export tool. Command:
```
./tools/admin-export --org acme-corp --days 30 --redact --format ndjson > acme_audit.ndjson
```

DevOps Bot: Export job started (job id: 88fd). ETA ~2m.

Ian (Solutions Eng): Export done, 2.3M lines. Pushing to secure share. Link: https://files.redwood/incoming/acme_audit_redacted_1758004321.zip (internal only)

Olivia (Security): I'll review redaction, check PII. Also confirm admin actions include user id, role changes, token creations, key rotations.

Ian (Solutions Eng): Sample log snippet:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-20T15:03:12Z","actor":"svc-deployer","action":"deploy.start","resource":"model-serving/instance-7","details":{"commit":"ae3f.."}}
```

Sarah (Sales): Customer also asked: retention SLA, who can query logs, and integration proof to their SIEM (Log forwarding / syslog).

Olivia (Security): Retention: meta: logs stored in S3 for 365 days, hot store 30 days, then lifecycle to glacier for 365+; retention doc link: https://confluence.redwood/retention/policies. Access control: RBAC via Okta groups, audit logs accessible to Security/Admins only. I'll add ACL screenshots.

Ian (Solutions Eng): For SIEM integration we have Fluentd forwarder + webhook. Example config for Splunk HEC:
```
<match audit.**>
  @type splunk_hec
  hec_host splunk.company
  token xxxxx
</match>
```
We can send a sample push.

Sarah (Sales): Perfect. Can Olivia draft a one-page cover email and attach redacted export + docs? I'll send to Acme InfoSec.

Olivia (Security): On it. ETA 90m. Also flag: we need to sanitize IPs & usernames—done.

Sarah (Sales): :thumbsup: Thanks team. Marking as POC deliverable.

DevOps Bot: ACL screenshots uploaded to secure share (link: https://files.redwood/incoming/acme_acl_1758004321.png)

Ian (Solutions Eng): Uploaded sample SIEM push logs as `splunk_hec_sample.ndjson` to the same share.

Sarah (Sales): Sending to customer in 2 hours unless any blockers.

Olivia (Security): No blockers from security side. Please blind-copy security@redwood.
